record.oneLiner: Twilio is a communications platform providing programmable APIs for SMS, voice, and messaging, authenticated via API keys and OAuth 2.0 with an official MCP server available.
record.verdictReason: Twilio provides broad REST API coverage, accessible via self-serve free sign up and authenticated via API keys and OAuth 2.0. They also host an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

evidence.quote: API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs.
Twilio Communications APIs now support OAuth 2.0. Upgrading to OAuth 2.0 makes your applications more secure than using traditional API keys or Auth tokens.
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required.
API keys are the preferred way to authenticate with Twilio's REST APIs.
Our MCP server, hosted at mcp.twilio.com/docs , exposes two tools: twilio__search – Search Twilio's APIs and documentation using natural language.
